scope_label: average first-failure time for items treated as nonrepairable
definition: For items treated as nonrepairable, mean time to failure (MTTF) is the average operating time until first failure.
explanation: It may be estimated from observed lifetimes or calculated from a fitted lifetime distribution.
The reciprocal of a failure rate gives MTTF only under a constant-rate exponential model; MTBF instead summarizes operation between failures of a repairable system.
